title: Polish Herring Curry
description: A unique twist on traditional Polish cuisine, this herring curry combines the flavors of Eastern Europe with the warmth of India.
instructions: Rinse the herring fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with yummy sauce and sprinkle with curry powder.
Bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, slice the onion and sauté in a pan until softened.
Mince the garlic and add to the pan, cooking for another minute.
Serve the herring on top of a slice of polish rye bread, with the onion and garlic mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with a sprinkle of curry powder and a dollop of yummy sauce.
